data.title: Template advice-to-outcome contract verified
data.context: The maintenance task had to leave active state before template-check could copy a clean public starter contract.
data.decision: Full scripts/check.sh passed with the explicit development-stack override, including validate, readback, status, template pairing, and the new recommendation promotion smoke.
consequences: The pinned release rule remains intact; development check used GO_STACK_ALLOW_DEV=1 only for this untagged local stack.

data.title: Template exact v0.3.8 pin verified
data.context: The local annotated stack tag v0.3.8 now points at the verified release commit.
data.decision: Full scripts/check.sh passed against GO_STACK at exact v0.3.8 without GO_STACK_ALLOW_DEV, including recommendation promotion smoke and template pairing.
consequences: The template is release-ready; remote pull remains unavailable until an explicitly authorized push of commits and tag.

data.title: Pin the public project template to v0.3.14 without exporting a fake project decision
data.context: The v0.3.14 runtime makes governing decisions mandatory for material/foundational work. Updating the public template changes the default workflow contract for future repositories, but the template cannot decide downstream product architecture on their behalf.
data.decision: Pin the template and its mechanical checks to immutable v0.3.14. Keep the synthetic project-boundary brief decision_ids empty; use this adoption decision only on the template adoption task so generated projects must record or inherit their own accepted governing decisions.
consequences: Fresh clones enforce the governing-decision gate.
Generated projects do not inherit an irrelevant accepted decision.
Template release pairing remains exact and reproducible.
